name: State Government Health Scheme (Golden Card)
benefit: The State Government Health Scheme has been implemented with the aim of providing quality healthcare facilities to all government employees, pensioners, and their dependents in Uttarakhand. Under this scheme, prescribed medical treatment is provided free of cost.
_eligibility_text: 1. All government employees and pensioners of Uttarakhand who have obtained Golden Cards and make monthly contributions are eligible under the scheme.
